saints.name: The Dedication of the Basilica of St. Mary Major
saints.title: Our Lady of the Snows
saints.shortBlurb: The commemoration of the great Roman basilica raised in Our Lady's honor on the Esquiline Hill…
biography: This day commemorates the dedication of the Basilica of St. Mary Major, the oldest church in the West honoring the Blessed Virgin Mary. An ancient tradition, which gives the day its older title of Our Lady of the Snows, tells of a summer snowfall on the Esquiline Hill in Rome marking out the ground where the church was to be built.

The present basilica was raised under Pope Sixtus III in the years after the Council of Ephesus of 431, which had solemnly proclaimed Mary to be Theotokos, the Mother of God. Adorned with its famous mosaics, St. Mary Major stands as one of the four great papal basilicas of Rome and a monument to the Church's devotion to the Mother of God.
saints.knownFor: The oldest Marian basilica in the West.
